## Experience

- INSAPP — Frontend Developer, Dec 2021 – now. Insurtech platform: frontend of 8 products (motor insurance OSAGO/KASKO,
  mortgage insurance, microloans showcase, cashback subscriptions in the Alfa-Bank webview, events, staff workstation,
  corporate site); 180+ branded partner landings on one codebase (fileReplacements, GitLab CI stage per landing);
  migration Angular 11/15 → 20–22; corporate site on Angular SSR + Payload CMS; white-label eSIM widget “Svyaz”;
  Claude Code agents for task triage, landing generation, code review and visual QA, MCP for Tracker, Figma, Swagger.
- GLOBUS — Frontend Developer, Jul 2018 – now. Client work from UX/UI prototype to production: Chemexsol (oil & gas
  online system), Yandex Delivery (site for international markets), Trullo (project management SPA).
- DEX technology — Frontend Developer, Feb 2015 – Jun 2017. SPAs, responsive layouts, REST API (AngularJS, jQuery).
- radikal.ru — Frontend Developer, Sep 2013 – Jul 2014. Markup and client-side JavaScript for a photo hosting service.
